purpose: Close the third item on OI-55's WHAT_IS_NOT_CLAIMED list -- 'anything about playlists other than 1A, or about Data as opposed to MC' -- by running a structural-completeness check over EVERY .root file under minerva_large_files rather than a sample of three.
verdict: 2365 of 2365 files structurally complete. Zero TRUNCATED, zero SHORT-fEND, zero NOT-A-ROOT-FILE, zero OSERROR. C's (B) valid-older-production conclusion now rests on full coverage of the tree Gates 1-4 consumed, not on three files of one playlist.
WHY_A_SECOND_INSTRUMENT_RATHER_THAN_RERU: BEN-196: a check's denominator must come from a different instrument than its numerator. C's numerator is ROOT 6.28's TFile::GetEND(); this one parses the 100-byte header per the file-format spec and never imports ROOT. Agreement between two readers is evidence; a tool agreeing with itself is not.
Cost is what made full coverage possible at all. C's probe does a full basket scan (2:23 CPU for one file); this reads 32 bytes per file, so 2365 files cost less than one of C's three.
This was run BECAUSE C's answer was the one lane A wanted to hear. The inherited session lesson is 'be most suspicious when a gate agrees with you.'

CROSS_INSTRUMENT_AGREEMENT.note: The three files C probed, read by both instruments. Eleven-digit agreement across three files is not a coincidence pass.

THE_DISCRIMINATOR: An interrupted xrdcp leaves a PREFIX, and a prefix still carries the original's header. So the header's recorded logical end-of-file describes a file larger than what is on disk: fEND > st_size. A valid older production is self-consistent and cannot produce that signature. fEND == st_size therefore excludes truncation without reading a single event.

COVERAGE_INGREDIENTS.note: Per CONVENTION-receipt-ingredients (BEN-077): the parts must sum to the total, so the numbers can contradict each other.

PROOF_THE_CHECK_CAN_FAIL.why: An all-OK sweep over a healthy tree is indistinguishable from a probe that returns OK unconditionally. Two separate demonstrations that the OK verdict is contingent on the bytes.
PROOF_THE_CHECK_CAN_FAIL.negative_control_on_real_data: A 1 MiB dd prefix of run00110000 was probed and reported TRUNCATED with fEND=17318473069 against size=1048576. The temp file was removed after.
PROOF_THE_CHECK_CAN_FAIL.built_in_self_test: fend_probe.py --self-test, 7/7 PASS, including two TRUNCATED cases in both header layouts, a SHORT-fEND case, a bad-magic case, and a check that the SAME PATH flips OK -> SHORT-fEND when bytes are appended.
PROOF_THE_CHECK_CAN_FAIL.self_test_run_on_both: 7/7 on the local Mac (python3) and 7/7 on Perlmutter login11 (/usr/bin/python3.11).

THE_TOOL_IS_THE_ONE_THAT_PRODUCED_THE_NU.why: A first draft produced the sweep; adding the self-test changed the file. Committing the improved tool beside a result generated by the draft would be a receipt whose instrument and number came from different code.
THE_TOOL_IS_THE_ONE_THAT_PRODUCED_THE_NU.action: The committed version was re-run over the full tree from scratch.
THE_TOOL_IS_THE_ONE_THAT_PRODUCED_THE_NU.note: The draft's log and the committed version's log are BYTE-IDENTICAL (same sha256), which is the evidence that adding the self-test changed no output.

WHAT_IS_NOT_CLAIMED: That the files are CURRENT. fEND == size proves structural completeness, not that the bytes match what the remote holds today. Complete and current are different claims and this tool makes only the first. C's constant-ratio argument, not this sweep, is what positively identifies a reprocessing.

Anything about the remote. OI-55's first two not-claimed items stand unchanged: nobody has read the remote headers (needs the DTN; Perlmutter 401s), and there is still no positive identification of whether the reprocessing added branches or events.
That the file CONTENTS are physics-correct. This is a structural check, not a checksum and not a validation of the events inside.

That the 54 MATFluxAndReweightFiles and 4 MParamFiles are part of the Gate 1-4 input set. They live under the same tree and were swept because excluding them would have been a choice; whether the analysis reads them is a separate question this receipt does not answer.
